evidence.notes: Buyer reported a torn seam on the coat and provided photos (msg:MSG-2003). Merchant reviewed the photos and confirmed the seam damage appears to be a manufacturing fault (msg:MSG-2004). The item was delivered on 2026-10-17 (shipment:SHP-2002). Store policy allows a full refund of the item price for unworn returns within 30 days (policy:returns) and notes that minor variations may occur (policy:descriptions).

input.notes: Buyer received a coat with a torn seam, confirmed by photos. Merchant acknowledged the defect as a manufacturing fault. Under the store's return policy, the buyer is entitled to a full refund of the item price (CAD 135.00). Offering a refund resolves the issue without requiring a return.
input.rationale: The buyer reported a genuine defect and the merchant confirmed it. Policy permits a full refund of the item price. A refund offer satisfies the buyer and aligns with store policy, making it the most appropriate resolution.
